title: Insights into the atmospheric persistence of α-endosulfan
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EM00296F, Paper
Loc T. Nguyen, Tam V.-T. Mai, Lam K. Huynh
The formation and transformation of a highly stable reactant-complex significantly enhance the atmospheric persistence of α-endosulfan, particularly at elevated temperatures.
